commit_scope: Reviewed and tested implementation commit; subsequent commits update delivery evidence only

source_coverage.workers_requests: offline adapter tested; adaptive approximate five-minute window; live unverified
source_coverage.subscriptions: account and configured-zone adapter tested; live unverified
source_coverage.rated_v1: parsed positive rows can alert; complete total and freshness unknown
source_coverage.other_products: billing/subscription visibility only; no fast metrics or cutoff

limitations: Best-effort monitoring is not a hard spending cap.
No live provider probe, deployment, alert receipt or observation window occurred.
Real metrics/inventory/probe evidence cannot currently authorize verified containment.
A stopped host requires an independently hosted health check.
Publication and production readiness remain separate owner gates.
owner_actions: Review private draft PR and evidence package.
Choose explicit account/resource enrollment, budgets and verified billing periods for a separate personal deployment.
Authorize exact observe installation and notification destination; provision protected read-token files outside chat/Git.
Verify live API capability, two scheduled observe runs, actual alert receipt and a 24-hour observation window.
Keep live cutoff disabled until a separate supported-metric/inventory design and approved disposable canary are verified.
Decide separately whether to publish the repository.
